units.source_text: 早晨清扫庭院，她们自然而然领略到了秋凉。

en.t: As they swept the garden in the morning, they naturally came to feel the coolness of autumn.

units.source_text: 小巧玲珑的阿雪，不知怎的，拿起一把大竹扫帚，显得特别天真，那风度活像一位小姐。

en.t: Small and delicate Oyuki, for some reason, picked up a large bamboo broom and looked especially innocent; her bearing was just like that of a young lady.
